long:
Phleb Lab Wellness in Richmond Heights, Ohio, offers personalized wellness support with Renee Blackmon, a Certified Functional and Nutritional Medicine Practitioner, Certified Nutrition Coach, and Functional Weight Loss Consultant. Our functional medicine approach considers nutrition, lifestyle, and everyday habits that influence overall well-being.

Services include health and wellness coaching, nutrition education, weight management support, and guidance on healthy lifestyle choices. We support adults seeking to improve their wellness while managing concerns such as ongoing pain, hormonal changes, and challenges with weight or energy.

Through individual consultations and follow-up visits, we help clients set realistic goals and develop practical habits they can maintain. Our coaching and education complement care from licensed medical providers. Services are available by appointment in a supportive setting where clients can ask questions, learn, and take an active role in their well-being.
size: My initial goal is to see approximately three wellness clients per week, offering in-person and virtual appointments around my teaching schedule. I plan to grow gradually while allowing time for personalized consultations, wellness plans, and follow-up support.
